title: Governance
subtitle: Discover the statutory bodies and leadership team that guide, supervise, and implement the actions of ACPDPH with transparency, integrity, and dedication.

generalAssembly.title: General Assembly
generalAssembly.p1: The General Assembly is the supreme and sovereign governing body of ACPDPH. It brings together founding and active members to set institutional directions and long-term strategic priorities.
generalAssembly.p2: It is responsible for approving strategic policies, adopting annual certified financial and narrative reports, electing members of the Board of Directors, and deciding on major organizational matters.
generalAssembly.p3: It convenes in ordinary session once a year and guarantees democratic, participatory, transparent, and inclusive governance.

board.conclusion: Through proactive leadership, the Board of Directors accompanies ACPDPH toward the realization of an inclusive society where persons with disabilities enjoy full rights.
